about: A realm's other text answers (GitHub #13250): the feature list and what adding to it answers, a revision's answer, the edit panes, the proposals, the listed realms, the made realms' rows for /og, and the card's want. "lines" names every line. "steps" are calls to a seeded public realm as its owner and as a visitor (the fixture's second key is a player's) with the status and body the server answers today: "vary_line" names a line's start whose number the run decides, and "has_line" says the answer lists every realm in the database and the fixture's line is one of them. "model_steps" need the planner's model: coax/web/api/test_realm_builder.py makes them as the owner of the realm proto/verse/realm-board-v1.json made (fixture-marsh), with the ask's and the plan's numbers written 41. aethyr/forge/lists.coax, spec.coax and listed.coax read the lines; aethyr/forge/lists-goldens.coax holds them through those files; coax/web/api/tests/realm_record_checks.coax makes the calls.

lines.says: the feature list: an ask, newest first; STATE applied, waiting or removing, KIND ask or remove
what adding an ask answers first: applied or waiting ("ask 0 gone" when its plan is gone); the board's rows follow
what a revision answers first: the new plan's number; the board's rows follow

lines.form: doc N M applied K waiting
lines.says: what a dropped document answers first: how many asks it made, applied and waiting; the rows follow
a row of the board, as in the spec (aethyr/forge/spec.coax)
under edit-v1/: the realm's revision now, the last line
a character's lore; a bar in the text is written as a space
a giver's quest: what it asks, three steps and its reward
lines.example: quest old-mott|Bring my oar|Find the oar|||A lantern

lines.says: a visitor's placed thing waiting for its owner: who, the thing, where, and how many of it the realm has before and after
the listed realms' first line: how many public realms there are
a public realm on /worlds, newest first (aethyr/forge/listed.coax)
a made realm as a row of /og's table: its page, its link preview's words and picture, and what is missing
lines.example: /realms/list-fixture|made||List Fixture|A meadow by day with 6 pine trees, where Old Mott lives. A world built on the Verse.|https://openagents.com/worlds/list-fixture|/og/default.jpg|List Fixture|default|1200|630|0|no picture of its own yet (its owner's next visit takes one)|line written from what is in it|
